protocol.scope: Same A77 three ImageNet images x SR4/Motion, sigma=.05, same H/y/seed/model/native1000 sampler.
protocol.controls: Fixed1000 table: per-step median of OTHER two images; mismatch: sorted-image cyclic donor within same task. Frozen using gamma traces only, no labels.
protocol.reuse: 12 original A77 DPS/SHRINK completed runs reused;12 controls newly sampled. No baseline replay.
protocol.timing: Fresh controls complete1000; A77 reference clocks historical, not same-session randomized timing. Fixed implementation retains unused online statistic arithmetic, so not optimized fixed runtime.
protocol.decision: Compare online SHRINK against both controls per image and across PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS; DPS comparison alone does not establish matching benefit.
protocol.resources: Allocated>=10GiB before load; measured real VJP peak+1GiB required before each run; no model/precision/grid changes.
protocol.limits: Three reused development images, donor traces paid in A77. Fixed table also preserves stage structure. No independent transfer claim.
